description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Legate Lanius triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat until no opponent controls a creature.
